component.name: Stack
component.description: Vertical flex container. Stacks children top-to-bottom with consistent spacing from the space.stack token scale. The primary building block for content hierarchy within a page section.

useWhen: Arranging content vertically with consistent spacing between items
Building a form, card body, or sidebar section where elements flow top-to-bottom
Composing a heading + body text + action group in a single vertical flow

notFor.because: Stack is always column direction. Horizontal spacing belongs to Inline.

donts.case: Nesting Stack inside Stack with the same gap just to group items
donts.because: Redundant nesting with identical gaps is visual noise with no structural benefit
donts.instead: Use a single Stack and rely on Box with padding to create visual grouping if needed
